texts.facts: The Sub-Inspector of Banashankari Traffic Police Station has filed the charge sheet against the accused No.1 for the offences punishable U/s.279 and 338 of Ipc, Sec.134(a and b) R/w.187 of M.V.Act and against the accused No.2 for the offences punishable U/s.146 R/w.196 and Sec.66(1) R/w.192 of M.V.Act. 2. It is the case of the prosecution that on 28-10-2020 at about 7.00 p.m. the 1st accused being the driver Auto Rickshaw bearing registration No.KA- 05/Ab-1263 drove the same on K.R. Road, from Bharathi Nursing home junction towards Upahara Sagar hotel junction in a rash and negligent manner C.C.No.202/2021 so as to endanger human life and he dashed to pedestrian who was crossing the K.R. Road, in front of Mtr Food store, from Umamehshwara adyatma Manidra towards Mtr food store. Due to the impact the pedestrian C.W.5 Sri Ramprasad N.A., aged about 52 years sustained grievous injuries. Further on the day of accident the accused No.1 did not provide medical aid to the injured nor he intimated the police about. Further on the day of accident the 2nd accused being the owner of the Auto Rickshaw bearing registration No.KA-05/AB-1263 had permitted the accused No.1 to drive the said vehicle and the said vehicle was not in possession of valid vehicle insurance and fitness certificate on the day of accident , thereby the accused No.1 is alleged to have committed the offence punishable U/s.279 and 338 of Ipc, Sec.134(a & b) R/w.187 of M.V.Act and the 2nd accused is alleged to have committed the offence punishable U/s.66(1) R/w.192 and Sec.146 R/w.196 of M.V.Act. 3. Upon taking cognizance, case came to be registered against the accused No.1 for the offences C.C.No.202/2021 punishable U/s.279 and 338 of Ipc, Sec.134(a & b) R/w.187 of Mv Act and the accused No.2 for the offences punishable U/s.66(1) R/w.192 and Sec.146 appeared before the court through their counsel and got enlarged on bail. Charge sheet copies furnished to the accused persons and thereby provision U/s.207 of Cr.P.C. duly complied with.
texts.arguments: To counter the said argument the learned counsel for the accused submits that in the instant case the injured is the manager in the temple. The said fact is disclosed by his wife in his complaint itself. The prosecution examined P.W.2 to 5 among them Pw..2 is the street vendor opposite to temple, P.W.3 is the watchman of the Banashankari Trps vs Lingappa G R on 16 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31195995/ 2 temple and P.W.4 is the Manager of the temple. The prosecution did not establish the chain link between the eye witnesses, prosecution has not examined any independent eye witnesses. Io claims about existence of cctv even the manager admits about existence of cctv, but intentionally the said cctv footage is not produced before the court which raises doubt about the case of the prosecution. The burden is upon the prosecution to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt, but prosecution was not successful in establishing the negligent act of the accused. To support the said contention no medical record is placed before the court, it is not C.C.No.202/2021 tenable in the court of law a person can do acting and court can accept his version. Here the burden is upon the prosecution to prove the mental condition by relevant documents which they failed to do so. Upon perusal of the over all evidence the prosecution is not successful in establishing their case of negligence. Accordingly he prays for acquittal of accused.

22. In the instant case the prosecution is alleging that the accused being the driver of the auto rickshaw drove the same in a rash and negligent manner and caused accident due to which the victim sustained grievous injuries and prosecution

Section 279 IPC deals with rash and negligent driving of any vehicle or riding on a public way in a rash and negligent manner so as to endanger human life or likely to cause hurt or injury to any person.

In order to constitute an offence U/s.279 of IPC, it must be established that the accused was driving the vehicle on a public way in rash and negligent manner to endanger human life or to likely cause to hurt or injury to any other person.
For the purpose of section 279 rash and negligent may be described as criminal C.C.No.202/2021 rashness or criminal negligence.
It must be more than mere carelessness of error of judgment.

The essential ingredients of section 279 are: (1) rash and negligent driving or riding on a public way, (ii) The act must be such as to endanger human life or likely to cause hurt or injury to any person.

10 C.C.No.202/2021 Prosecution contend accused drove the vehicle in rash and negligent manner and dashed to injured.
All the eye witness admits the injured was proceeding in a junction and accident has taken place in the center of the junction.
Witnesses clearly admits the injured was not proceeding in the zebra cross and he was proceeding in the middle of the road which means the negligence on the part of the injured is clearly noticeable.
The burden is upon the prosecution that accused being the driver of the auto drove the same in high speed / rash manner and caused accident.
To prove that aspect no convincing evidence is forth coming from the side of prosecution.
Complainant claims the accident spot is 100 mtrs away from the temple.
As per Ex.P.6 it is just 20ft away from the temple.
P.W.4 claims he has seen accident, but as discussed earlier he did not depose that he was coming behind the injured
then his version of seeing the accident live is not possible and as per his version he cannot see the accident live sitting inside the temple.
His evidence is also doubtful.
The prosecution failed to establish that accused drove the vehicle in rash and negligent manner and thereby C.C.No.202/2021 caused the untoward incident.
Further all the examined eye witnesses are related to temple administration and it is established fact that the injured is also employee of the temple.
Which means P.W.2 to 4 are interested witnesses and their witness has to be analyzed with great caution.
As discussed above they have not seen the accident live and they cannot be termed as eye witness.
Further the prosecution did not made attempt to examine any independent witness to prove their case which is fatal to their case.
